nodes.label: Skill: eventar-graph-refresh
nodes.rationale: Refresh graphify-out incrementally, commit tracked outputs only. Rules: (1) graphify --update then cluster-only, no timeout binary on macOS; (2) judge health against previous graph (nine self-loop edges in tests existed 2026-10-15); (3) commit with pathspec git add + git commit --only; (4) leave out dated backup folders and .graphify_labels.json.sig; (5) look for partial .graphify_chunk_*.json, abort rather than merge partial; (6) code-only refresh leaves docs out of manifest; (7) read docs in line ranges since compressed reads drop sections; (8) verify table/migration/SECURITY DEFINER claims by script (73 verified, 5 corrected), never hand-patch graph.json; (9) confirm GRAPH_REPORT.md keeps Summary, Graph Freshness, God Nodes; (10) graph is code map, decisions stay in state doc (Ivan 2026-11-14).
